svg.title: Five Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-five-to-seven-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Five Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions; subtitle: Base: 2 FT + 3 C; scaled operation: 3 FT + 4 C; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time and C means contractor. The first five seats form the Conservative and Base-Case pod; the final two seats are additions for the Scaled Small-Team scenario. Contractor headcount does not imply full-time hours, and seat descriptions do not set compensation.; caption: Conservative: $150,000 revenue × 8% = $12,000 owner net with five people. Base: $575,000 × 14% = $80,500 with five. Scaled: $1,000,000 × 20% = $200,000 with seven. All revenue is gross operator resale proceeds.; stages: label: FT 1: commercial owner; value: Core seat; bid and cash authority; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own buyer demand, final bid ceilings, funding allocation, seller exceptions, and inventory markdown decisions. Review cash committed by pickup deadline before authorizing another purchase.; label: FT 2: inventory and remarketing lead; value: Core seat; asset-to-sale execution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain asset records, photograph condition, coordinate preparation, publish listings, qualify buyers, and verify fulfillment. Reconcile serial numbers across receipt, repair, and sale documents.; label: C 1: transport and rigging specialist; value: Core seat; removal execution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Quote loading and freight before bidding, reserve pickup capacity, document custody, and deliver within site restrictions. Escalate missing forklifts, access constraints, and loading damage immediately.; label: C 2: inspection and repair technician; value: Core seat; condition and repair control; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform asset-class inspections, produce defect estimates, execute bounded repairs, and record test results. Seek a revised commercial decision before exceeding the authorized repair ceiling.; label: C 3: title and bookkeeping specialist; value: Core seat; documents and reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track title submissions, resale documentation, tax records, purchase invoices, and bank receipts. Separate tax liabilities, inventory cash, direct costs, and overhead in the asset-level ledger.; label: FT 3: operations lead; value: Scaled addition; sixth person; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add dedicated scheduling, yard control, carrier coordination, and cycle-time ownership when concurrent lots exceed the core team's capacity. The commercial owner retains final bid authority.; label: C 4: field inspection specialist; value: Scaled addition; seventh person; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Expand inspection coverage without substituting listing photographs for condition evidence. Use standard test sheets and return inspection findings before the bid worksheet is finalized.

rect.title: label: FT 1: commercial owner; value: Core seat; bid and cash authority; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own buyer demand, final bid ceilings, funding allocation, seller exceptions, and inventory markdown decisions. Review cash committed by pickup deadline before authorizing another purchase.

text.title: Own buyer demand, final bid ceilings, funding allocation, seller exceptions, and inventory markdown decisions. Review cash committed by pickup deadline before authorizing another purchase.

rect.title: label: FT 2: inventory and remarketing lead; value: Core seat; asset-to-sale execution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain asset records, photograph condition, coordinate preparation, publish listings, qualify buyers, and verify fulfillment. Reconcile serial numbers across receipt, repair, and sale documents.

text.title: Maintain asset records, photograph condition, coordinate preparation, publish listings, qualify buyers, and verify fulfillment. Reconcile serial numbers across receipt, repair, and sale documents.

rect.title: label: C 1: transport and rigging specialist; value: Core seat; removal execution; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Quote loading and freight before bidding, reserve pickup capacity, document custody, and deliver within site restrictions. Escalate missing forklifts, access constraints, and loading damage immediately.

text.title: Quote loading and freight before bidding, reserve pickup capacity, document custody, and deliver within site restrictions. Escalate missing forklifts, access constraints, and loading damage immediately.

rect.title: label: C 2: inspection and repair technician; value: Core seat; condition and repair control; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Perform asset-class inspections, produce defect estimates, execute bounded repairs, and record test results. Seek a revised commercial decision before exceeding the authorized repair ceiling.

text.title: Perform asset-class inspections, produce defect estimates, execute bounded repairs, and record test results. Seek a revised commercial decision before exceeding the authorized repair ceiling.

rect.title: label: C 3: title and bookkeeping specialist; value: Core seat; documents and reconciliation; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track title submissions, resale documentation, tax records, purchase invoices, and bank receipts. Separate tax liabilities, inventory cash, direct costs, and overhead in the asset-level ledger.

text.title: Track title submissions, resale documentation, tax records, purchase invoices, and bank receipts. Separate tax liabilities, inventory cash, direct costs, and overhead in the asset-level ledger.

rect.title: label: FT 3: operations lead; value: Scaled addition; sixth person; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Add dedicated scheduling, yard control, carrier coordination, and cycle-time ownership when concurrent lots exceed the core team's capacity. The commercial owner retains final bid authority.

text.title: Add dedicated scheduling, yard control, carrier coordination, and cycle-time ownership when concurrent lots exceed the core team's capacity. The commercial owner retains final bid authority.

Use standard test sheets and return inspection findings before the bid worksheet is finalized.

text.title: Expand inspection coverage without substituting listing photographs for condition evidence. Use standard test sheets and return inspection findings before the bid worksheet is finalized.

Assumptions: FT means full-time and C means contractor. The first five seats form the Conservative and Base-Case pod; the final two seats are additions for the Scaled Small-Team scenario. Contractor headcount does not imply full-time hours, and seat descriptions do not set compensation.
